subject: Packaging options for ClearPoint pilot — addon weave & upgrade path
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging options for ClearPoint pilot — addon weave & upgrade path

Alex — great to chat last week. Attached is a concise proposal that lays out two pilot packaging options we discussed and a recommended upgrade path if you scale:

1) Compact Pilot (recommended to start)
   - Core text generation + embedding bundle
   - 2k concurrent reqs, shared prefix cache, basic observability
   - Upgrade path: pin to Dedicated capacity or add burst pool

2) Elastic Pilot (throughput-first)
   - Higher throughput, optional quantized model variant, KV caching tuned for chat
   - Upgrade path: move to Dedicated with sliding scale pricing or add feature bundles

Separately, you asked about "addon weave" — the ability to buy features (reranking, long-context, function-calls) as swappable modules. The attached feature matrix maps which features are included at each tier and which we can bolt on. A few quick notes:

- Downgrade guardrails: we support prorated rollbacks within the first 90 days, but feature-level state (e.g., long-context KV cache) may require a short reindex window.
- Pricing: we included an optional 10% pilot discount and a path to a volume-based credit as usage grows past month 3.
- Next step: If you want to lock an upgrade window (e.g., pilot → dedicated in 6 months), we can draft SOW language to reserve capacity and anchor pricing.

[Attachment: ClearPoint_Pricing_v1.pdf (PDF, 124 KB)]
[Attachment: feature_matrix_clearpoint.xlsx (XLSX, 48 KB)]

Can you confirm which pilot option you want to pursue and whether procurement needs additional budget language up front?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Moore <alex@clearpointhealth.com>

Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging options for ClearPoint pilot — addon weave & upgrade path

Jordan — thanks, got the attachments and read through them. A couple quick clarifying questions before we pull procurement in: 

- If we pick Compact Pilot and then want to add long-context and reranking in month 2, how is billing handled? Do we get billed prorated for the addon usage only, or do we need to migrate plans?
- The downgrade guardrails sound good; can you confirm if there is any data egress cost tied to moving to dedicated capacity? Our security team is conservative about movement of logs and KV state.
- The 10% pilot discount — is that standard across customers or do you have room to extend a slightly deeper pilot concession if we commit to a 9-month conversion milestone?

Also copying our procurement lead Sarah so she sees the docs. We may need an explicit 60-day SLA for pilot availability during our clinical evaluation window.

— Alex
Alex Moore
Head of ML Platforms, ClearPoint Health
alex@clearpointhealth.com
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moore <alex@clearpointhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging options for ClearPoint pilot — addon weave & upgrade path

Alex — quick answers below, and happy to hop on a call to walk procurement through the posture.

- Billing for addons: We bill usage-based for add-ons during the pilot (prorated daily). You do not need to migrate plans to enable an addon; it is enabled as a metered feature. If you later choose to move to a different tier, we reconcile any committed credits at migration.
- Data egress & state: Moving from hosted pilot to Dedicated involves an internal snapshot of KV/cache state; we do not export customer data externally. If you require an on-prem/private migration there are nominal setup fees (covered in the SOW) but no per-token egress at standard moves. We can include a specific clause for audit logs.
- Pilot concession: We can extend the pilot discount to 15% if you sign a conversion milestone that enrolls you into a 9-month ramp commitment (details in the attached pricing). That concession requires a signed MOU within 30 days of pilot start.
- SLA: We can offer a 60-day pilot availability SLA with a single-point-of-contact and a 24/7 incident escalation path for the clinical eval window.

Next steps I suggest:
- Jordan to capture which pilot and requested features;
- We draft a one-page MOU (non-binding) capturing the 15% concession and conversion milestone;
- Ben to prepare SOW + DocuSign link once accepted.

[Attachment: ClearPoint_Pricing_v1.pdf (PDF, updated 2026-10-14, 129 KB)]

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

Alex — great to see alignment. Per Lauren's note, we'll prepare three short documents: 

1) One-page MOU (captures 15% pilot concession, 9-month conversion milestone).
2) Draft SOW (includes reserved capacity language, upgrade window, and an audit-logs clause).
3) DocuSign packet (SOW + MOU) for signature and a HubSpot deal update.

I'll attach the SOW draft here for your review and will send the DocuSign link once you confirm the Compact Pilot + long-context addon as the starting configuration. If procurement needs budget language, we'll include a sentence that anchors pricing for 90 days post-signature.
